how.title: Four simple steps to freedom
how.step1Desc: Locate a verified storage partner near you in Colombo, Galle, or Ella.
how.step2Desc: Reserve your space in seconds with a few taps on your phone.
how.step3Desc: Check in your bags and get them sealed with our tamper-proof tags.
how.step4Desc: Show your booking ID to pick up your bags whenever you're ready.

features.title: Designed for the modern traveller
features.feature1Desc: Every hub is manually verified for security and service quality.
features.feature2Desc: Your bags are protected by LKR 150,000 insurance and unique seals.
features.feature3Desc: Book directly from your browser. No downloads or accounts needed.
features.feature4Desc: Change of plans? Extend your storage time easily online.
features.feature5Desc: Our team is always ready to help you with your storage needs.
features.feature6Desc: Our hub partners are locals who can give you the best travel tips.
